verdict.rationale: WooCommerce describes itself as open source with 'full control' of your data, and its REST API lets store data be read in JSON, an open format. This gives a real but developer-oriented path to getting data out. There is no documented one-click full export or exit guide, and the migration guides cover moving onto WooCommerce, not leaving it. missing for 10: a documented first-party full-store export tool (e.g., CSV/JSON bulk export of products, orders and customers), evidence that 'all' data can be exported, migration-away documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: WooCommerce is the open-source commerce platform for WordPress that gives you full control: of your checkout, your data, your costs.
This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format
WooCommerce CLI (WC-CLI) offers an efficient way to manage WooCommerce (WC) stores via the command line.
